'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Fink LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Fink]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Username:''' Foxhome
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
